old_caption: The video captures a dance class taking place in a spacious studio with wooden floors and large mirrors along one wall. The instructor, dressed in a black sleeveless top and black pants, leads the class through a series of dance moves. He begins by extending his arms out to the sides, then raises them above his head while stepping forward with his right foot. His movements are fluid and precise, demonstrating the choreography for the students. The students, positioned behind him, mirror his actions, following his lead attentively. The studio is well-lit, with natural light streaming in from windows above the mirrors. A clock on the wall indicates the time, and various pieces of equipment, such as a fire extinguisher and a small table with items on it, are visible in the background. The atmosphere is focused and energetic, reflecting the dynamic nature of the dance routine being taught.

caption: The video captures a man in a black sleeveless shirt with a pink-and-yellow logo, black trousers and multicoloured sneakers performing a turning dance in a studio whose mirror wall, ballet barre and round clock frame a wooden floor. With his back to the camera he extends his arms sideways, then rotates into a side profile, bending his arms in front as one foot lifts. Facing the mirror, he opens his arms wide and glances left, then turns to a crossed-arm profile and returns to a back-to-camera stance with arms out. His arms draw toward his chest, rest on his hips, and drop to his sides, after which he holds a near-static wide-legged posture with slight sway. He lifts his arms outward into a broad horizontal pose, then bends them toward his front. The mirror tracks his orientation, showing his front when he faces it and his back when he turns away. Reflected participants in teal, purple and yellow stay largely in place behind him. The camera stays fixed throughout the excerpt.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
